title: Isandro and the Undertow
author: Edmund Ravensworth
blurb: Theo Okafor, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
